purpose: Literal published-method attempt; separate from author release replay and any corrected method
target: Final PMLR paper, Algorithm 1, Eq. 5 right side, Eq. 12, Eq. 14, B.1

specified.training_loop: Visit every training window once per shuffled epoch; include final smaller batch
specified.soft_gate: sigmoid(beta*(score+shift)), shift found by 32 bisections to sum(gate)=k
specified.masked_prediction: prediction*soft_gate; re-solve printed Eq.5 over all assets
specified.covariance: Raw 100-day window sample covariance, shrink 0.10 toward trace/n identity; jitter only if Cholesky fails
specified.historic: Mean over full training segment, rolling per-sample covariance
specified.conventional_oscar: Eq.1 covariance risk norm(L.T@y), hard top-k transformed scores, re-optimize selected covariance submatrix
specified.reported_metric: Daily realized-return mean / sample standard deviation; no annualization

explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.optimizer_primary: Plain SGD matches the displayed theta <- theta - eta*gradient update; actual experimental optimizer not stated
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.optimizer_sensitivity: Adam, if run, is labeled separately; not substituted after test comparison
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.units: No scaler; raw simple returns used consistently as features, targets, covariance and decision-loss returns
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.test_boundary: All test targets evaluated using immediately preceding 100 observations, including pre-split history
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.equivalent_numerical_coordinates: q=F*y; a=F^-T*1; b=F^-T*mu; maximize (b/||b||).q subject to ||q||<=1,(a/||a||).q>=0; recover y=F^-1*q,t=sum(y). Same feasible set and argmax as Eq.5; used after direct coordinates caused inaccurate-unbounded numerical status. F=L for printed DFL, F=L.T for Eq.1 baseline.
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.precision: float32 MLP; float64 loss, covariance and conic computations
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.shuffle: Python Random(seed), each sample exactly once per epoch
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.batch_remainder: Keep final smaller batch, averaging over its actual size
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.input_panel: Frozen current-vintage panel, not verified stable-membership cohort
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.nonfinite_policy: Stop run; preserve failure; no gradient clipping, skipped samples or replacement solver
explicit_reconstruction_choices_not_clai.evaluation_validity: Report budget violations >1e-3 and do not treat affected Sharpe as valid budget-constrained performance

irreconcilable_or_missing: Printed Eq.5 norm(L@y) is not covariance risk when covariance=L@L.T; preserved for the literal DFL attempt
Soft gate mass does not enforce the claimed exact holding cardinality; no straight-through or hard DFL added
t=0 is allowed, where portfolio recovery y/t is singular; B.1 offset value unspecified
Exact epoch count, optimizer, activation, beta, regularization, dtype and preprocessing not fully published
Original constituent and adjusted-price snapshot unavailable
SDR realized-cardinality matching search parameters and threshold unavailable
Appendix B.3 and main-text mSSRM descriptions differ
scope: DFL plus conventional hard OSCAR Historic/PFL; SDR and mSSRM not claimed reproduced by this attempt
